google.source: Google Search Central / Search Console Help
facts: Dedicated Search Generative AI performance reports cover visibility in generative AI features on Search, including AI Overviews and AI Mode.
Google states the insights were rolled out worldwide as of 2026-08-31.
The report exposes generative AI impressions and breakdowns such as pages, device, and country; ordinary Search performance remains a separate aggregate view.

bing.source: Bing Webmaster Tools / Bing Search Blog
facts: AI Performance reports citation activity across Microsoft Copilot, Bing AI-generated summaries, and select partner AI integrations.
Core views include cited pages, grounding queries, citation activity over time, and page-query mapping.
Preview capabilities add Intents, Topics, Citation Share, and Compare.
Bing documents the data as aggregated/sampled trend data rather than a complete log of every AI answer.

measurement_policy: Do not infer citation counts from ordinary Google Search clicks/impressions.
Do not treat missing or throttled Bing data as zero citations.
Do not treat GA4 AI referrals as a complete citation count; referrals measure visits that reached the site.
Only populate prompt-level citation observations from direct engine observations or first-party AI visibility reports.

connected_search_appearance_snapshot.interpretation: The connected Search Console data surface exposed only PRODUCT_SNIPPETS for search_appearance in this query. This does not prove zero Google Generative AI visibility; the dedicated Google Generative AI report is a separate first-party view.

google_generative_ai.connector_status: dedicated Generative AI report not exposed through the connected Search Console connector in this run
google_generative_ai.action: Use/export the first-party Generative AI report when a connector exposes it; never infer AI Overview/AI Mode impressions from ordinary web Search rows.

chatgpt_search.prompt_level_citation_api: not available in current connected tools
chatgpt_search.interpretation: referral sessions are observed outcomes, not a full citation count

historical_ga4_snapshot.interpretation: No growthos_* custom events were present in this historical GA4 event-name snapshot. Their absence is a measurement/configuration finding, not evidence that the tools were unused.

custom_growthos_events.interpretation: No growthos_* events were observed before Phase 10 activation; activation now forwards these events through the installed Google tag when available. Future collection must be verified from GA4 after traffic occurs.

purchases.interpretation: GA4 returned zero purchases in this window; this alone does not prove zero real orders or perfect purchase tracking.
